shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, an optional Circinus corpus-prevalence bridge, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Current release: v1.2 shipped; v1.3 in progress (audit remediation, see "2026-08 audit remediation" below).**

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` is banned suite-wide with one deliberate exception: the dev palette's category line. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. Helpers: `SearchField`, `ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`/`DrawWell`/**`DrawPlate`**, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, **`DrawCheck`**, **`ModuleRow`**, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/**`ResetGuiState`**.
- **Text-scaling rule:** never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window`. Size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.
- **`DrawPlate` (2-draw card):** border colour as one filled rect + fill inset 1px = 2 `GUI.DrawTexture` instead of 5. **Gated to `Prefs.UIScale == 1f`**, where `UIScaling.AdjustRectToUIScaling` reduces to plain floor/ceil so the result is provably pixel-identical; fractional scales keep vanilla's per-edge snapping. *Not yet visually verified at 125/150% — that is the one open visual risk.*
- **`BeginScroll` is re-entrant:** saved `GUI.skin` scrollbar styles live on a STACK, not four fields, because `ErrorModule.DrawSection` runs inside the inspector's active scroll view. `ResetGuiState()` unwinds stranded entries and is called from every window's `finally`.

### `TextMetrics` (shared measurement memo) — the framework the mod was missing
Memoised `Text.CalcHeight`/`CalcSize`, keyed on **(text, rounded width, resolved GameFont, that style's fontSize, WordWrap)**. `Text.Font`'s getter already returns the *coerced* font (Tiny→Small when `TinyFontSupported` is false), so an accessibility-pref change can never serve a stale metric. Cap-then-clear at 8192. **Main thread only** (documented, not locked). Every `Text.CalcHeight`/`CalcSize` call site in the mod routes through it.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow` — **now gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`**. Left list (culled) + right inspector + **add-on tray**.
- **Toolbar B** is a right-to-left cursor (`RightButton`): Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, **Vanilla log** (only when a decorator mod is detected), then search fills the rest.
- **Compat hint strip** (one-time, dismissible) below Toolbar B. **Frame-latched** (`_hintFrame`) because its own Dismiss button flips the setting that hides it — reading live would drop a control between OnGUI passes and shift every later IMGUI id.
- **Repeat chip** shows `x{repeats}+{suppressed}` in Warn colour when the throttle held repeats back.

### Log-window ownership + compat (`LogWindowCompat`, `LogWidgets`) — CRITICAL
**The problem:** replacing the vanilla log window silently deleted other mods' UI. Detected by TYPE presence (what matters is whether the decorating code is loaded), not packageId:
- **HugsLib** (`HugsLib.Logs.LogWindowExtensions`) — ships the community-standard `AddLogWindowWidget(WidgetDrawer, WidgetAlignMode)`, rendered by a prefix on `EditWindow_Log.DoMessagesListing`. It registers *Share logs* (LogPublisher), *Files*, *Copy*; any mod may add more. All of it vanished.
- **Archotech Logs** (`KKArchotechLogs.UI.LogWindowPatch`) — Diagnostics/Export/colour-toggle postfixes on `EditWindow_Log.DoWindowContents`. Its `MainButtonWorker_LogShortcut.Activate()` calls `new EditWindow_Log()` directly, bypassing our patches → a second divergent window.

**Fixes shipped:** (1) `yieldLogWindow` setting — every log redirect returns to vanilla, mod behaves as if uninstalled; (2) "Vanilla log" toolbar button; (3) one-time hint strip; (4) **`LogWidgets` hosts HugsLib's widgets** — reflects its private `widgets` list, rebinds each `Drawer` to our identically-shaped `LogWidgetDrawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate` (NOT `DynamicInvoke` — that would pay reflection cost per widget per pass), draws them in a recessed-well tray so foreign vanilla-styled buttons read as a contained boundary rather than style leakage. Throwing widgets are dropped like HugsLib does. `LogWidgets.Any` is **frame-latched** — the tray changes the body rect, so a mid-frame flip would resize the list and shift control ids.

### `LogThrottle` — optional suppression of repeating log lines (default OFF)
**The engine facts:** `Log.Error/Warning/Message` evaluate `StackTraceUtility.ExtractStackTrace()` as an ARGUMENT, i.e. *before* `Enqueue` can notice a repeat — so every repeat pays a full frame walk + big string alloc; the repeat cap is 99 and below it every occurrence also does a synchronous `Debug.Log*` disk write; all inside `lock(logLock)`. **The gap:** `LogMessageQueue` only combines with `lastMessage`, so dedupe is strictly *consecutive* — interleaved spam (A,B,A,B) never combines, never caps, never stops writing.
**Design:** allocation-free FNV-1a over the text + 64-slot ring; first `Threshold`(5) always pass; 10s quiet window resets; `Environment.TickCount` not `Time.frameCount` (`Log.Error` can be called off-thread); own short lock; **fails open** on any exception and latches off. Summary lines are drained from the `Root.Update` hook, never emitted from the prefix (would re-enter `Log`).
**Honesty guarantees:** suppressed counts surface in the row chip + tooltip, and `ImpactAssessor.EffectiveRepeats` folds them into severity so the throttle can never make an error look milder than it is. `LogAnalysis.Impact` is keyed on the effective count.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`) — location is NOT frequency
`TickSignals`/`FrameSignals` only prove *where*; a perf claim requires recurrence. `RepeatingThreshold=3`, `SpamThreshold=10`; `hot = (tick||frame) && repeating`. Curated `MaxImpact` caps the level. **"Known issue" badge = `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`** — set only by KnownIssues/ModIssues/CommunityBugs. **Cached on `LogAnalysis`, keyed on effective repeats** (the one input that mutates).

### `IssueScoring` — ONE matcher for all four knowledge surfaces
Weights (ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2) now live in exactly one place, shared by the shipped `KnownIssueDef` library, mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json`, API-registered sources and the community DB. Previously duplicated by hand in two files. Keyword tests use allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase` `IndexOf`. `IssueTextUtil` holds the former copy-pasted `StripBom`/`Lower`/`CompileRegexes`/`PairKey`.
- **`RegexOptions.Compiled` deliberately dropped** in the shared compiler: on Mono it emits IL via Reflection.Emit at construction and is never reclaimed, across ~100 patterns that now run once per *analysed message* (cached), not per frame. **Reasoned, not measured** — FrameParser's genuinely per-line patterns keep it.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention — AUDITED 2026-08
**Every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled source, with a `source file:line` provenance comment.** Trap classes: exact punctuation (`TryMakePreToilReservations()` has parens), keyed-translation indirection (mod-list warnings render Core Keyed values: "must be loaded before"), runtime-native strings not in Assembly-CSharp (`wrapper dynamic-method` = Mono, `Could not load type` = .NET, IMGUI = Unity), and messages that don't exist (a missing translation key logs NOTHING). Shipped defs never name a third-party mod; `fix` text is always user-actionable.
- **`Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 44 entries**, all with provenance comments. Includes 4 self-healing vanilla fallbacks (`MDT_RaidArrivalFallback`, `MDT_RaidStrategyFallback`, `MDT_PawnGroupFallback`, `MDT_WeatherFallback`), all `ignorable` + `maxImpact=Low`. `MDT_HarmonyConflict` reworded per the Harmony execution model (a single mod's patch produces the same `wrapper dynamic-method` frames, so no "conflict" claim without ≥2 foreign patchers).
- **`Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 entries.** **`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries.** Workflow: gunzip → edit plain → `gzip -9` → delete plain. **Pending: sync fixed entries to the live `ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` repo.**
- **Glossary — ~26 terms.** `AllTerms()` is now cached (was 52 `.Translate()` + a fresh list per call, ~3× per OnGUI pass).

### Analysis modules + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by Score. 13 modules in flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`. `ErrorContext.RankedMods()` is cached and invalidated by `Merge` (4 modules foreach `Culprits`, each previously triggering a full 5-key LINQ sort).
- **`Module_ReflectionBridge` + `ReflectionBridgeExtension` (NEW):** declarative compat — bind a foreign static type's `Describe(string,string)` / `ImplicatedMod(string,string)` entirely from XML via `modExtensions`. Probe once; silent when absent; **loud `WarningOnce` only on contract drift**; nulls every binding on failure; never `FromLibrary`. Generalises `Module_CircinusCorpus`, which is left in place (verified in-game, run #132) rather than migrated. **No speculative Archotech def shipped** — its static API surface was never verified, and fabricating one would violate the mod's own factuality rule.
- **`Module_ModIssues`** now scores mod-shipped files *and* `KnowledgeSources.Pool` (API-registered) as one pool.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules (incl. reflection bridges) must score **< 1**.

### Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen contract
`ApiVersion = 2`. v1: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`. v2: `RegisterKnowledgeSource(IKnownIssueSource)`, `RegisterLogWidget(id, drawer, alignRight)`, `AnalysisCompleted` event (fired once per message from `Compute`, handlers sandboxed), `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. Reflection-bindable; documented in `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md`. `LogWidgetDrawer` is signature-identical to HugsLib's `WidgetDrawer` so one method serves both.

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
`ModernDevToolsSettings` / `SettingsPage.Draw` (canonical superset) / `Dialog_Modules` (quick subset). Both now share `Palette.ModuleRow` + `SettingsPage.ToggleModule`. Cards: **Log window** (yield + detected decorators), **Log spam** (throttle), General, Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited. **Viewport-culled**: `BeginScrollView` clips pixels but doesn't skip draw code, so every card now measures (memoised) but skips drawing when outside a **frame-latched** window (`UpdateCullWindow`, 300px margin) — latched because `BeginScrollView` writes the scroll position during the wheel pass. Def counts cached (were 4 full scans per pass).

### Experimental hardening + `HardeningPatches` (on-demand patching)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, two toggles, off by default. **All 7 hardening patches and the 3 throttle prefixes are now installed only while their feature is on** — a guard clause makes the body free but not Harmony's dispatch, and these sit on `Window.WindowOnGUI` (every window, every pass), `WindowStack.WindowStackOnGUI` (every frame) and `Log.Error` (every error in the game).
**One permanent patch replaces them: a postfix on `Verse.Root.Update`** (both `Root_Entry.Update` and `Root_Play.Update` call `base.Update()`), which drives `HardeningPatches.SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()`. Apply MUST happen there and not from the settings UI: the settings window runs inside `Window.WindowOnGUI`/`WindowStackOnGUI`, and patching a method currently on the stack is the one genuinely dangerous use of the runtime API. Failures latch `_broken`.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` now only raises a volatile `_dirty` flag; the swap happens on the next main-thread read (was an off-thread table swap).

### Tool 2/3: dev actions window + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search, `OpenAt`). `Window_ModernDevPalette` reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`; **resolved nodes are now cached** against a hash of `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` (`Dialog_Debug.GetNode` splits the path and runs a capturing-lambda `FirstOrDefault` per segment — previously per pin per frame). Pin/reorder sets `_pendingResizeFrame` and is applied at the top of a LATER frame: `ResolveNodes` returns the shared cache list Draw is iterating, and changing the row count mid-frame shifts IMGUI ids.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.

## 2026-08 audit remediation (phases 0–9) — BUILT, NOT YET RUN IN GAME
Full audit report: `Documentation/Audit-2026-08.pdf` / `.html` (15pp, certainty-scored).
Phase 0 correctness (B1 index-build race, B2 settings try/finally, B3 re-entrant BeginScroll, B5 off-thread cache clear) · 1 compat escape hatches · 2 cache pass (TextMetrics, per-analysis derived caches, RankedMods, rail counts, palette nodes, ignore matcher) · 3 KB culling · 4 on-demand hardening patches · 5 API v2 + HugsLib widget host · 6 log throttle · 7 dedupe · 8 reflection bridge · 9 two-draw card.
**Everything is static analysis + build-green only. Nothing has been profiled and nothing has been launched.** Before release: (a) in-game smoke test of every window, (b) verify the 2-draw card at 100/125/150% UI scale, (c) confirm HugsLib's Share logs/Files/Copy appear in our tray and work, (d) profile phases 2–3 with Dubs Performance Analyzer to confirm the predicted wins, (e) bump `Version` to 1.3 + write update notes.

## Release / publishing state
v1.2 shipped: Workshop item 3771602203, git `98f6ca6` on `Astryls/ModernDevTools`. **Outstanding from v1.2:** push the fixed community-bugs entries to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (live fetch source still serves pre-audit patterns).

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
